scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details
scenarios.reasoning: The agent arrived at what appears to be the correct answer, but the evidence trail is concerning. The project name and target framework are well-supported by tool output. However, the specific assembly name and version numbers don't appear in any visible tool result, suggesting the agent either had access to truncated data not shown in the timeline or hallucinated these details. The agent also failed to explicitly call out MSB3277 as the error code. The approach was reasonable - trying multiple tools when the first didn't work - but the inability to read the large warnings file and the failed bash command limited the evidence gathering.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 as the error code
Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)
Mentioned which target framework (net8.0) is affected by the conflict
